name: gamedev-lanes
description: A lane-scoped agent roster and the orchestration rules that make it work, extracted from a shipped AI-built adventure game. Each lane owns a declared file scope; the orchestrator plans and delegates but never executes. Ships the per-project documents each lane reads — orientation doc, constitution, decision log and spec guides — and a reference cloud platform with free-tier hosting, player sign-in, storage and keyless CI/CD, both of which scaffold into a project.
